source: IFRC Emergency Field Manual / UNDAC Structural Assessment Guidelines

translations.en: Establish a 10-metre exclusion zone around the damaged structure. Remove all persons immediately.
translations.bi: Mekem eksklusion zon blong 10 mita araon long bilding we hemi damaged. Tekemaot olgeta man naoia.
translations.tpi: Mekim eksklusion zon 10 mita raun long bilding i bagarap. Rausim olgeta man nau.
translations.ht: Etabli yon zòn eksklizyon 10 mèt alantou estrikti a ki domaje. Retire tout moun imedyatman.

translations.en: Listen and call out for trapped survivors before entering any collapsed section.
translations.bi: Harim mo singaot blong sek sapos gat man we oli stuk insaed bifo yu go insaed long eni pati we hemi foldaon.
translations.tpi: Harim na singaut bilong painim ol man i stap hait insait bifo yu go insait long pes i pundaun.
translations.ht: Koute epi rele pou sivivan ki bloke anvan ou antre nan nenpòt seksyon ki te efondre.

translations.en: Photograph all four sides of the structure. Note visible cracks, leaning walls, or roof collapse before any entry.
translations.bi: Tekem foto blong olgeta fo saed blong bilding. Naot olgeta krak, wol we emi lean, oa ruf we hemi foldaon bifo entri.
translations.tpi: Kisim piksa bilong ol 4 het bilong bilding. Naotim ol krak, wol i lin, o ruf i pundaun bifo yu go insait.
translations.ht: Pran foto kat kote estrikti a. Note fissure vizib, mi ki penche, oswa effondrement twa anvan nenpòt antre.

translations.en: Locate and shut off utilities: gas, electricity, water. Do not use open flame near damaged structure.
translations.bi: Faenemaot mo katem of olgeta utility: gas, elektrisiti, wota. No yusum open flam klosap long bilding we hemi damaged.
translations.tpi: Painim na katim ol utility: gas, kakaruk, wara. No yusum open paia klostu long bilding i bagarap.
translations.ht: Locate epi ferme sèvis piblik: gaz, elektrisite, dlo. Pa itilize flanm louvri pre estrikti domaje.

translations.en: Mark structure with standardized INSARAG color code: Green (safe), Yellow (restricted use), Red (unsafe — do not enter).
translations.bi: Makem bilding wetem INSARAG kola kod: Grin (sefti), Yelo (restrikted yus), Red (no sef — no go insaed).
translations.tpi: Makim bilding long INSARAG kala kod: Grin (sef), Yelo (yusim liklik tasol), Ret (no sef — no go insait).
translations.ht: Make estrikti a ak kòd koulè INSARAG: Vèt (an sekirite), Jòn (itilizasyon restrenn), Wouj (pa an sekirite — pa antre).
